The [[Standard year/Legends|year]] '''25,797 before the Battle of Yavin''', also known as '''10,666 after the Tho Yor Arrival''', was a year in [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic history]]. That year, the [[Je'daii Ranger]] [[Lanoree Brock]] departed [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], and would not return for another four years.<ref name="DOTJ">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref>
